verdicts.quote: "OAuth is required for public integrations available to all Front customers unless you obtain an exception from us."
verdicts.reason: Public OAuth is supported and required for multi-tenant/public integrations, so OAuth2 is the primary auth a toolkit would use.

verdicts.quote: "You can create a developer account by signing up here. You’ll get access to a free developer environment… Developer accounts are limited to 3 teammates"
verdicts.reason: Front offers self-serve, free developer accounts that provide a sandbox and the ability to build without contacting support.

verdicts.quote: "Our primary backend API… allows you to read, create, update, and delete a wide range of data across Front’s various entities, from Contacts to Comments."
verdicts.reason: The Core API exposes many entities with full CRUD, indicating broad coverage.

verdicts.quote: "Front’s MCP server allows external AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to connect to Front."
verdicts.reason: This is an official Front Help article describing Front’s own MCP server.

verdicts.quote: "Smaller teams may also be subject to a security or legal review."
verdicts.reason: Buildable today with self-serve creds and docs, but public distribution/listing involves review; hence caveats.
